capabilities: Extract highlights, bold or all text from daily notes, the active note, a folder, or picked notes
Append or copy extracted items to a target note or the clipboard
Render live extracted items via a highlights-extractor code block
Apply per-weekday templates when daily notes are created
Archive daily notes into MM-YYYY subfolders
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the dynamic code block and date-based filtering depend on matching the Daily Notes date format setting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect ==highlighted== or **bold** text scattered across many notes into a single review or summary note.
summary: Extracts highlights, bold text or full note content from daily notes, folders or selected notes into a summary note, plus daily-note template tools.
